_comment: Per-route first-load JS in bytes, pinned by `npm run bundle:pin` from the static export in out/. Measured with `npm run build` — Turbopack plus scripts/strip-inline-scripts.mjs — because that is the artifact the deploy actually ships, inline flight chunks and all. `next build --webpack` splits chunks differently and omits the stripped inline chunks, so its numbers are ~4-14% lower and are not comparable; _builder records which one these were pinned with and check-bundle-budget.mjs refuses a mismatch. Re-pin deliberately, in the same commit as the change that moved a number.
